<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" agent="Bob" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="part3-attested-proof" name="Part 3 – Attested Proof"> <mxGraphModel dx="1618" dy="956" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#333333;arcSize=5;fontSize=15;" value="<b>Attester</b><br>attestation key pair<br>trusted by Issuer" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="260" x="390" y="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="issuer" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#333333;arcSize=5;fontSize=15;" value="<b>Issuer (Keycloak)</b><br>Trusted Key IDP<br>validates attestation" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="280" x="810" y="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="verifier" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#333333;arcSize=5;fontSize=15;" value="<b>Verifier</b><br>verifies issuer sig<br>+ key binding" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="260" x="1240" y="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lifeline-wallet" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=none;dashed=1;dashPattern=8 8;strokeColor=#666666;strokeWidth=1.5;" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="150" y="160" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="150" y="660" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lifeline-attester" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=none;dashed=1;dashPattern=8 8;strokeColor=#666666;strokeWidth=1.5;" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> style="endArrow=none;dashed=1;dashPattern=8 8;strokeColor=#666666;strokeWidth=1.5;" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="950" y="160" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="950" y="660" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lifeline-verifier" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=none;dashed=1;dashPattern=8 8;strokeColor=#666666;strokeWidth=1.5;" value=""> style="endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;fontSize=15;align=center;verticalAlign=bottom;labelBackgroundColor=none;" value="1 - Send public proof key"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="150" y="216" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="520" y="216" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="msg2" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;fontSize=15;align=center;verticalAlign=bottom;labelBackgroundColor=none;" value="2 - Key-attestation JWT
(wraps proof key, signed by Attester)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="520" y="288" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="150" y="288" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="msg3" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;fontSize=15;align=center;verticalAlign=bottom;labelBackgroundColor=none;" value="3 - Credential Request (proofs with attestation)
proofs.attestation (or proof JWT + key_attestation header)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="150" y="372" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="950" y="372" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="msg4" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;fontSize=15;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;labelBackgroundColor=none;edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=1;entryY=0.5;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" value="4 - Verify attestation sig
against Trusted Key IDP"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="990" y="430" /> <mxPoint x="990" y="430" /> </Array> <mxPoint x="950" y="430" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="950" y="430" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="msg5" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;fontSize=15;align=center;verticalAlign=bottom;labelBackgroundColor=none;" value="5 - Verifiable Credential
(cnf claim contains proof public key)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="950" y="500" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="150" y="500" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="msg6" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;fontSize=15;align=center;verticalAlign=bottom;labelBackgroundColor=none;html=1;" value="6 - VC Presentation + Key-Binding JWT<div><br/></div>"> <mxGeometry relative="1" x="0.0016" y="-20" as="geometry"> <mxPoint as="offset" /> <mxPoint x="150" y="568" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="1370" y="568" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="note" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fillColor=#f8f8f8;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1;fontSize=15;fontColor=#000000;arcSize=3;" value="7 - Issuer sig ✓ Holder binding ✓
(Attestation verified by Issuer at issuance)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="500" x="1120" y="604" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
